sections.section_title: I3C broadcast/direct RSTACT CCC transfer, as controller
sections.text_helper: Section 42.9.4 "I3C broadcast/direct RSTACT CCC transfer, as controller" in chapter 42 (Improved inter-integrated circuit (I3C)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1717.
sections.section_content:
Figure601 illustrates I3C broadcast (write), direct write and read RSTACT CCC, as
communicated on the I3C bus, and as programmed when acting as controller.
[Figure 601. I3C broadcast, direct read and direct write RSTACT CCC, as controller]
